verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's agentic-workflows marketing says its agents auto-remediate level 1 alerts and automatically escalate high-risk or complex cases for human expert review, which covers the escalation half of the story. A user-defined policy limiting what the agent auto-remediates is only implied: the Starter Plan note says agent configurations there cannot be customized, suggesting other plans allow it, but no documentation shows the controls. Missing for 10: documented policy controls for the scope or thresholds of auto-remediation, first-party technical docs on agent escalation rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
